=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the man in the 24 October 2018 Facebook photograph on shelby.abercrombie.9.
The profile lists Male and From Enterprise, Alabama.
Gold 97 is East Tuskaloosa, Alabama.
The 1998 Worlds qualifier listing is Enterprise, Alabama.
The 30 June 2015 photograph on the same profile shows the same man in an Alabama hoodie.
The same profile shows Conan and roleplaying games.
A member search of facebook.com/groups/starwarsccg returned no results for Shelby Abercrombie and no results for Abercrombie.
This profile is distinct from the pulled namesake facebook.com/shelby.simonton.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph.
The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot.
Identification stays on Talk.
See [[:File:Shelby Abercrombie portrait.jpg]], [[:File:Shelby Abercrombie Facebook portrait.jpg]], [[:File:Shelby Abercrombie Facebook 2015.jpg]], and [[:File:Shelby Abercrombie Facebook 2019.jpg]].

=== Namesake photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The dested circular is facebook.com/shelby.simonton, a woman who married Cooper Abercrombie on 11 July 2015. The 1997 Dagobah Regionals (Mobile) champion was already named Shelby Abercrombie. That photograph is a namesake. It was pulled from the article and from Squadron Members.
